meta.gradeRule: The school rule, followed by the v3 sheet: Reception = PK4 (Kindergarten readiness, no CCSS of its own); WRM Year N = US grade N-1 (Year 1 = K, Year 2 = Grade 1, ... Year 6 = Grade 5). A step's CCSS codes may sit above that grade (flag "above") or have none (flag "non-ccss", Beyond CCSS).
